run_Trainer_multi_eval: run the Trainer_multi class to evaluate depth estimation metrics on a validation dataset
run_eval_measure_multi: run the eval_measure_multi method to compute depth error metrics across all validation samples
run_compute_depth_errors_VA: run the compute_depth_errors_VA method to calculate depth prediction errors against ground truth
run_predict_poses: run the predict_poses method to predict camera poses between input frames for reprojection
run_process_batch: run the process_batch method to pass a minibatch through the multi-frame depth network
